title: How to add a note (delete this example)
body: Each note is one block in this file. I copy a whole block from the opening brace to the closing brace, paste it above this one, then change the date, title, body and tags.
The date goes year-month-day. The body is a list of paragraphs, each in quotation marks and separated by a comma. I can add a link like [this](https://www.folger.edu) or *italics* inside a paragraph.
